discovery.summary: Check whether a domain expires within a future horizon
discovery.description: Resolve a domain via IANA RDAP bootstrap and its authoritative registry, then compare the published expiration date with a caller-selected future horizon. Returns expiring_soon, not_expiring_soon, unregistered, or human_review. Registry grace/renewal policies vary; this is a registration timing signal and not proof of ownership, control, legitimacy, security, fraud risk, or business identity.
discovery.resource_description: Determine whether an authoritative RDAP domain expiration date falls within a caller-selected future horizon. Returns expiring_soon, not_expiring_soon, unregistered, or human_review. This is a registration timing signal only and does not prove ownership, control, legitimacy, security, fraud risk, or business identity.

buyer.task: Determine whether an authoritative RDAP registration expiration date falls within a caller-selected future horizon.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure only independently verified external settled purchases, not HTTP 200 responses, probes or tests.

sources.refresh_policy: authoritative source lookup on each paid request, subject to adapter caching behavior
sources.cache_policy: source-specific adapter caching; no new cache introduced by spec

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; payment is not settled.
